items.titleEn: With Deadline looming, Gausman improving but doesn't want to go anywhere
bodyEn: BOSTON -- We’ve reached that uncomfortable spot on the calendar when the Trade Deadline casts a shadow on every game.

The Blue Jays lost to the Red Sox on Sunday, 6-1, to drop two of three at Fenway Park, but the story of the day is how each of these individual performances could impact the Deadline, particularly from the Blue Jays’ veterans on expiring deals.
This is what mattered most:
1. Man in the spotlight: Kevin Gausman
Was that it?

Gausman’s next start would line up for Saturday, Aug. 1, at home in Toronto. If the Blue Jays are still positioned as clear sellers at that point, it’s possible that the Blue Jays could choose to hold Gausman back if trade talks are ongoing ahead of the Aug. 3 Deadline. There’s still some uncertainty baked into this, but that’s the spot Gausman and the Blue Jays are in now.

This still hasn’t been a strong stretch for Gausman, but Sunday’s performance was a step up from his last start against the Rays, at the very least. Gausman allowed three runs on five hits through six innings, striking out six batters while walking one.
As it stands today, Gausman has made 147 starts for the Blue Jays, which ranks him ninth in franchise history. Gausman’s 846 1/3 innings rank 11th.
2. The July of George
This looks more like the George Springer who led the Blue Jays to the top of the American League East a season ago, and eventually, the World Series.

Springer now has multiple hits in five of his last seven games, his energy suddenly evident in this lineup. The early half of Springer’s 2026 season was dragged down by a fractured toe, and while it’s difficult to measure how much the postseason run was still wearing on the 36-year-old physically, it couldn’t have helped. The version of Springer we’re seeing right now, though, is full of life and driving the ball consistently.

There’s a risk of this being too little, too late, but even if this still leads to a trade for the Blue Jays ahead of the Aug. 3 Deadline, it can only be good news. A few weeks ago, it looked like Springer’s experience and postseason pedigree would be his main selling points to contenders. If you can throw a hot streak on top of that at the right time, those conversations get much more interesting.

The Blue Jays’ players keep insisting that anything can happen, too. If they want to pull off a miracle run and win 15 in a row like the Red Sox just did, then Springer will need to be leading that run, too.
3. Big picture: The Wild Card mess

The Guardians, now holding the final Wild Card spot, lost Sunday to the Rays, but still hold a 5 1/2-game lead over the Blue Jays. In between, you’ll still find the Twins, Astros, Mariners, Orioles and Tigers, so this isn’t getting any less complicated.

The best way to look at this is still: How many games back of the final spot would the Blue Jays need to be in order to avoid selling on Aug. 3? Three games feels so close, but even then, you’re one of six or seven teams vying for one spot.

Keep an eye on those teams in the race, too, if any of them begin to signal that they’re beginning to buy or sell. This Trade Deadline feels like a logjam waiting on these teams, but it can’t last forever, and perhaps this weekend’s trade between the Red Sox and Nationals with Connelly Early for Curtis Mead will get things rolling.
items.titleZh: 交易截止日临近，高斯曼状态回升但无意离开
items.summaryZh: 交易截止日临近，蓝鸟老将高斯曼状态回升，但表示不愿离队。
bodyZh: 波士顿——我们已经到了日历上那个令人不安的时刻，交易截止日给每场比赛都投下了阴影。
蓝鸟周日以1比6输给红袜，在芬威球场三场系列赛中输掉两场，但当天的故事在于每个人的表现如何影响交易截止日，尤其是蓝鸟那些合同即将到期的老将。
以下是最重要的几点：
1. 焦点人物：Kevin Gausman
就这样吗？
Gausman的下一次先发预计在8月1日周六，于多伦多主场。如果届时蓝鸟明确作为卖家，那么在8月3日交易截止日前，如果交易谈判正在进行，蓝鸟可能会选择扣住Gausman。这仍存在不确定性，但这就是Gausman和蓝鸟目前的处境。
对Gausman来说，这仍然算不上表现强劲的时期，但至少周日的表现比他上次对阵光芒时有所进步。Gausman在六局中失三分，被击出五支安打，三振六人，保送一人。
截至目前，Gausman已为蓝鸟先发147场，排名队史第九。他的846又1/3局投球排名第11位。
2. George的七月
这看起来更像是那个带领蓝鸟上赛季登顶美联东区、并最终赢得世界大赛的George Springer。
Springer在过去七场比赛中五场有多个安打，他的活力突然在这条打线中显现出来。Springer的2026赛季上半段因脚趾骨折而受到影响，虽然很难衡量上赛季的季后赛征程对这位36岁老将的身体有多大消耗，但肯定没有帮助。不过，我们现在看到的Springer充满活力，持续击出强劲的球。
这可能有太少、太晚的风险，但即使这仍然导致蓝鸟在8月3日交易截止日前将其交易，这也只会是好消息。几周前，看起来Springer的经验和季后赛血统是他对竞争球队的主要卖点。如果你能在正确的时机再加上一波火热的势头，那些对话就会变得有趣得多。
蓝鸟球员们一直坚持认为一切皆有可能。如果他们想要实现奇迹般的连胜，像红袜刚刚那样连赢15场，那么Springer也需要领跑这场连胜。
3. 大局观：外卡乱局
守护者目前占据最后一个外卡席位，周日输给了光芒，但领先蓝鸟仍有5.5场。在这之间，还有双城、太空人、水手、金莺和老虎，因此情况并未变得简单。
看待这个问题的最佳方式仍然是：蓝鸟需要落后最后一名多少场才能避免在8月3日成为卖家？三场感觉很近，但即便如此，你仍是六七支争夺一个席位的球队之一。
也要关注那些竞争球队，如果其中任何一支开始表明他们开始买入或卖出。这个交易截止日让人觉得是一大堆球队在等待，但不可能永远持续下去，也许本周末红袜和国民之间用Connelly Early换来Curtis Mead的交易将开启局面。

items.titleEn: Tiedemann resumes rehab, touches 97.7 mph in scoreless inning at Single-A
bodyEn: BOSTON -- This has been a long time coming for Ricky Tiedemann, the Blue Jays’ No. 10 prospect who we’ve barely heard from in nearly two years.

It had been 706 days between Tiedemann’s last Minor League appearance in 2024 and his first rehab appearance this season, back on June 16. One outing later, though, Tiedemann had some neck discomfort and received injections, leading to another month on the shelf.

Now, finally, Now, finally, Tiedemann is resuming his rehab with the Tommy John surgery behind him. In what the Blue Jays hope will be the final "start" of a rehab assignment for the gifted 23-year-old, he made an appearance Sunday with the Single-A Dunedin Blue Jays.
This is what you need to know:
How did he perform?
Tiedemann allowed one hit and struck out two over a scoreless inning on 18 pitches. He looked sharp, too, averaging 96.4 mph with his fastball with a peak of 97.7 mph.

Results don’t matter much at this point for the lefty, but still, you can call this one a success. His best pitch of the afternoon came on a 97 mph fastball, up and in on a left-handed batter for strike three.
What’s next?

Tiedemann’s early outings will be planned out, likely including several days in between. Step one comes tomorrow, when Tiedemann begins to recover from this one. From there, he needs to get back into the groove of throwing, recovering and repeating that process over and over.

Eventually, the Blue Jays would like to jump Tiedemann from Dunedin back up to Triple-A Buffalo. He is expected to remain in this bullpen role for now, pitching in shorter stints. Given Tiedemann’s injury history, that seems to be the likelier role for him long-term, at least until he can reestablish himself.
What are they saying?
Back in Spring Training, Tiedemann sounded like a young pitcher with a new lease on life. He looked more like a pitcher, too, after spending a couple of years looking like an NFL linebacker.
Tiedemann is still built big and strong, but he’s learned over the years that pitching isn’t just a strength game. He’s developed in this sense, both physically and mentally.

“You see a lot of guys who are wiry and lanky, or they’re big guys, but you’ll never see a guy who is shredded out there year-round,” Tiedemann said back in February. “It’s not what a pitcher does to stay out there. Finding that out and finding the right weight where I feel easy, efficient and athletic -- and just staying healthy -- that’s the biggest thing. I did gain weight before I got hurt and I felt really strong, but I wasn’t as quick or as efficient or as smooth as I should have. Now, I [am].”
What else?
Tiedemann is on the Blue Jays’ 40-man roster, added last November to protect him ahead of the Rule 5 Draft. This is important, even with August and September in mind.
If the Blue Jays sell at the Trade Deadline and are no longer competitive in September, that opens the door to anyone and everyone on the 40-man.

A lot needs to go right between now and late September for Tiedemann. Given that he’ll be built up carefully, let’s call the “rehab” portion of this at least another month, taking us into late August or even early September. Tiedemann also needs to be pitching and recovering well from each outing ideally with shorter gaps in between. If all of that goes right, the odds are higher than 0%, at least, that we see a glimpse of Tiedemann in late 2026.

If nothing else, though, Tiedemann setting himself up for a “normal” offseason would be a great step. He hasn’t had one of those in a few years, and would once again be one of the most interesting arms in camp next spring.
items.titleZh: Tiedemann恢复复健，在1A无失分局中投出97.7英里快球
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟潜力新秀Tiedemann在1A复健赛中投出97.7英里，表现犀利。
bodyZh: BOSTON -- 对于Ricky Tiedemann来说，这一刻已经等了很久。他是蓝鸟队排名第10的潜力新秀，近两年来我们几乎没听到他的消息。
从Tiedemann在2024年的最后一次小联盟出场，到本赛季6月16日的首次复健出场，中间隔了706天。然而，仅一次出场后，Tiedemann就感到颈部不适并接受了注射，导致他又休战了一个月。
现在，终于，Tiedemann在完成Tommy John手术后重新开始复健。蓝鸟队希望这位23岁的天才球员能完成复健任务的最后一次“先发”，他于周日代表1A的Dunedin蓝鸟队出场。
以下是需要了解的信息：
他表现如何？
Tiedemann用18球投完一局无失分，被打1支安打，送出2次三振。他看起来状态很好，快速球平均时速96.4英里，最高达到97.7英里。
对于这位左投手来说，现在的结果并不重要，但这次出场仍可称为成功。他当天下午的最佳一球是一记97英里的快速球，投向左打者的内角高位，三振出局。
接下来是什么？
Tiedemann早期的出场会有计划安排，可能间隔几天。第一步是明天，Tiedemann将开始从这一场中恢复。然后他需要重新找回投球、恢复并反复重复这个过程的感觉。
最终，蓝鸟队希望将Tiedemann从Dunedin直接提升到3A的Buffalo。他预计暂时会继续担任牛棚投手，进行短局数出场。考虑到Tiedemann的伤病史，这似乎更可能是他长期的角色，至少在他重新证明自己之前。
他们怎么说？
在春训时，Tiedemann听起来像是一位重获新生的年轻投手。在经历了几年看起来像NFL线卫的身材后，他现在看起来也更像投手了。
Tiedemann依然高大强壮，但多年来他学到，投球不仅仅是力量游戏。他在身体和心理上都已有所成长。
“你会看到很多瘦长型的球员，或者大个子，但你永远不会看到一年到头都是肌肉线条分明的球员，”Tiedemann在二月份说道。“这不是投手保持状态的做法。找到合适的体重，让我感到轻松、高效和灵活——并且保持健康——这才是最重要的。我在受伤前增重了，感觉非常强壮，但我不够快速、高效或流畅。现在，我是了。”
还有呢？
Tiedemann在蓝鸟队的40人名单上，去年11月加入以保护他免受规则5选秀的损失。考虑到8月和9月，这一点很重要。
如果蓝鸟队在交易截止日出售，并且在9月不再有竞争力，那么40人名单上的任何球员都有机会。
从现在到9月底，Tiedemann需要很多事情顺利进行。鉴于他会谨慎地逐步提升，复健部分至少还需要一个月，也就是到8月底或9月初。Tiedemann还需要每场投球后恢复良好，并且最好间隔时间更短。如果一切顺利，我们在2026年底看到Tiedemann亮相的概率至少大于0%。
不过，至少让Tiedemann拥有一个“正常”的休赛期将是一大步。他已经好几年没有这样的休赛期了，明年春天他有望再次成为训练营中最令人感兴趣的投手之一。

items.titleEn: Sánchez (right ankle) joins Single-A Dunedin for rehab assignment
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Jesús Sánchez is back in game action down in Single-A Dunedin, putting him on track to potentially return to the Blue Jays by next weekend.

After going 1-for-3 in a Florida Complex League game on Thursday, this was Sánchez’s first game back with a full-season affiliate as he rehabs his right ankle sprain. Nearly a month ago, in late June, Sánchez jammed his foot awkwardly on the bottom of the outfield wall while he was backpedalling for a catch.
Here’s everything you need to know about Sánchez’s rehab.
How did he perform?
Sánchez played five innings in left field in the first half of Dunedin’s Saturday doubleheader and went 0-for-2 with a walk and a run scored.

Also appearing in that game was veteran reliever Yimi García, who has been stuck in a long rehab process this season with multiple pauses along the way. García threw a scoreless inning with one strikeout, but his fastball averaged just 92.9 mph, below where it’s been in the big leagues (96 mph). He’ll continue to build back up in hopes of returning this season.
What’s next?

Sánchez could see a bit more action in Dunedin, given that he can continue to work on his rehab at the Blue Jays’ player development complex across town. Once he’s ready, though, Sánchez will likely shoot right up to Triple-A Buffalo for his final tune-up before returning to the Blue Jays.
What are they saying?
When Sánchez returns, there’s no sense easing him back in or limiting his reps. The Blue Jays want that bat right back in the lineup.
“We want him to play,” manager John Schneider said pre-game Saturday. “Hopefully, he’ll generate some offense and get a chance to play pretty consistently.”
What else?

Sánchez has one year of arbitration remaining after this season, so while he’s not the most obvious trade candidate by any means, everything has to be on the table ahead of the Deadline for the Blue Jays. Sánchez is making $6.8 million this season and is due for one last raise heading into ‘27.

Acquired this spring for Joey Loperfido, Sánchez represented a swing on upside and power by the Blue Jays. At times, it’s worked, but Sánchez’s seven home runs and .753 OPS over 73 games haven’t done much to change the trajectory of the Blue Jays’ lineup. Sánchez’s bat has also been dragged down by his defense, with a team-worst Fielding Run Value of -7.

Trades could clear the way for Sánchez to play nearly every night down the stretch, though, and that could be useful for a Blue Jays organization which needs to assess its outfield heading into 2027. The front office is facing trade decisions on Daulton Varsho and George Springer, and if Myles Straw sticks around, he has an $8 million team option ($1.75 million buyout) for them to consider.

If Sánchez can return and play out the final 50-plus games, that should help to inform the Blue Jays’ offseason. It’s already clear they’ll need a center fielder -- ideally a long-term option like Varsho represented these past few years -- but that need could spill into the corner spots, too.
items.titleZh: Sánchez（右脚踝）前往1A邓尼丁进行康复
items.summaryZh: Sánchez在1A邓尼丁开始康复，有望下周回归蓝鸟。
bodyZh: 波士顿——Jesús Sánchez在1A邓尼丁重返赛场，这使他有可能在下周末前回归蓝鸟。
在周四的佛罗里达综合联赛中3打数1安打后，这是Sánchez在康复右脚踝扭伤期间首次随完整赛季附属球队出赛。大约一个月前，即在6月下旬，Sánchez在后退接球时右脚尴尬地卡在了外野墙底部。
以下是你需要了解的关于Sánchez康复的一切。
他表现如何？
Sánchez在周六邓尼丁双赛第一场中担任左外野手打了五局，2打数0安打，有一次保送并得到一分。
同样出现在那场比赛中的还有老将后援投手Yimi García，他本赛季一直陷入漫长的康复过程，途中多次暂停。García投了一局无失分并有一次三振，但他的速球平均仅92.9英里/小时，低于他在大联盟的水平（96英里/小时）。他将继续恢复状态，希望本赛季能回归。
下一步是什么？
Sánchez可能会在邓尼丁多打一些比赛，因为他可以在镇对面的蓝鸟球员发展中心继续康复训练。不过，一旦他准备好了，Sánchez很可能会直接升到3A水牛城进行最后的调整，然后回归蓝鸟。
他们怎么说？
当Sánchez回归时，没有必要让他慢慢适应或限制他的出场次数。蓝鸟希望他的球棒立刻回到阵容中。
"我们希望他上场，"总教练John Schneider在周六赛前表示。"希望他能贡献一些进攻，并有机会稳定出场。"
还有什么？
Sánchez在本赛季结束后还有一年薪资仲裁资格，因此虽然他在任何情况下都不是最明显的交易候选，但在交易截止日前蓝鸟必须把所有选项都摆上桌面。Sánchez本赛季年薪680万美元，在即将进入27赛季前将迎来最后一次加薪。
Sánchez是今年春天用Joey Loperfido交易来的，代表着蓝鸟对潜力和力量的一次尝试。有时确实奏效，但Sánchez在73场比赛中打出7支本垒打和.753的OPS，并未改变蓝鸟打线的轨迹。Sánchez的球棒还被他的防守拖累，他的防守跑垒价值为-7，位列全队最差。
不过，交易可能会为Sánchez在赛季末段几乎每晚都出场铺平道路，这对于需要在进入2027赛季前评估外场阵容的蓝鸟管理层来说可能很有用。管理层面临关于Daulton Varsho和George Springer的交易决策，而如果Myles Straw留队，他有一份800万美元的球队选项（买断费175万美元）供他们考虑。
如果Sánchez能够回归并打完最后50多场比赛，这将有助于蓝鸟的休赛期决策。已经明确的是，他们需要一名中外野手——理想情况下是像过去几年Varsho那样的长期选项——但这种需求也可能延伸到角落外野位置。

items.titleEn: Cease strengthens his Cy Young case with one-hit shutout of Red Sox
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Dylan Cease, standing on the mound with his hands reaching for the sky after throwing 120 pitches, didn’t look like a man on a 48-57 team. That’s why this matters.

Cease’s talent is only matched by his stubbornness on these special days, creating an unstoppable force. In Saturday’s 6-0 win over the Red Sox, he threw the Blue Jays’ first complete game one-hitter in 16 years, another night flirting with history after he took a no-hitter into the ninth inning earlier this month.
This matters to Cease, a pitcher who openly chases greatness.

Manager John Schneider would have had to drag Cease off that mound in the ninth. On the second-last batter of the game, an animated Cease called his own challenge, then pumped his fist when it was overturned for strike three. He was ready to challenge the final pitch of the game, too, which was called for his 12th strikeout. For two hours and twenty-five minutes, he owned Fenway Park.

"You don’t see this very often,” Schneider said. “Dylan is kind of a throwback pitcher. He’s durable and he thrives on that stuff. You don’t see this much. The no-hitter attempt in San Francisco, you just don’t see this much. Dylan is evolving as a pitcher. I wanted to give him every chance to finish it.”
By the numbers:
This was Cease’s third career complete game. He threw another one-hitter in 2022 and his no-hitter against the Nationals on July 25, 2024.
The first one-hitter by a Blue Jays pitcher since Shaun Marcum on August 16, 2010. Eight days prior to that, Brandon Morrow had done the same while striking out 17.
Only 10 pitchers in franchise history have thrown a complete-game shutout with one or zero hits allowed (a combined 15 times).
His 120 pitches are a career high, the most in MLB this season and the most a pitcher has thrown since Justin Verlander threw 121 on Aug. 31, 2025.
Cease is the first pitcher to throw at least 118 pitches in two outings in the same season since teammate Shane Bieber, who did it in 2021 with the Guardians.
Let’s throw a fun fact on the pile, too. Schneider was Shaun Marcum’s roommate in High-A Dunedin and Triple-A Syracuse back in his playing days. It’s been a while.

Whether a team loses it was for a week, a season or a decade, there need to be reasons to watch. The late 1990s and early 2000s were bleak times for the Blue Jays, but Carlos Delgado was in the lineup every night, and every fifth day, Roy Halladay took the hill. The ‘26 Blue Jays aren’t about to tailspin into another ice age in Toronto, but still, this feels like a lost season in need of some memorable moments.

Even if the season-long results aren’t there, fans just want to see their own passion reflected back. That’s why it’s so important to see Cease doing this exactly how he did it, asking for more and proving that he could do it. It’s another sign of the incredible trust he’s earned from Schneider and pitching coach Pete Walker, too, who just keep letting the big dog eat.

“That means a lot to me,” Cease said. “I went in after the seventh and I was like, ‘Can I get 110 today?’ Just to see if I could get a complete game. They let me go 10 over. There were a lot of foul balls in that last inning, but it was awesome. I’m very happy they let me go for that."

A few pitches into this game, you would have never seen it coming. Frankly, it looked likelier that Cease would last just a few innings. He sat near 93 mph in the first inning, a worrying number from a pitcher who typically lights up the radar gun and can touch 100 mph. Oddly enough, though, this forced Cease to “pitch”, as Schneider put it, and find some weak contact to keep him above water.

“My body was cranky early, so I was just working with what I had and making sure I threw strikes,” Cease said. “When we got to the fifth and I’ve got a no-hitter going, my body was loosening up a little bit. By the end, I had the kill in sight. I was just going for it.”
The race is officially on, too, between Cease and Cam Schlittler for the AL Cy Young Award, and games like these just keep reminding people why Cease has a shot.
items.titleZh: Cease 完封红袜仅被击出一安打，巩固塞扬竞争力
items.summaryZh: Cease 投出蓝鸟16年来首次一安打完封胜，巩固塞扬奖竞争力。
bodyZh: 波士顿——Dylan Cease 在投完120球后站在投手丘上，双手伸向天空，他看起来不像是一支48胜57负球队的球员。这正是这场比赛的意义所在。
Cease 的天赋只有在这些特殊的日子里才能与他的固执相匹敌，形成一股不可阻挡的力量。在周六6比0战胜红袜的比赛中，他投出了蓝鸟16年来的首次一安打完封，这也是继本月初他投出无安打比赛进入第九局后，又一次与历史擦肩而过的夜晚。
这对 Cease 来说很重要，他是一位公开追求伟大的投手。
总教练 John Schneider 在第九局不得不用拖的把 Cease 拉下投手丘。在比赛的倒数第二名打者中，情绪激动的 Cease 自己喊出了挑战，并在改判为第三好球后握拳庆祝。他也准备挑战比赛的最后一球，那球被判为他的第12次三振。在两个半小时的时间里，他主宰了芬威球场。
“你很少看到这样的情况，”Schneider 说。“Dylan 是一位复古型投手。他非常耐用，并且在这种情境下表现出色。你很少看到这样的表现。在旧金山的无安打尝试，你真的很少见到。Dylan 正在作为投手不断进化。我想给他每一个完成比赛的机会。”
数据层面：
这是 Cease 职业生涯第三次完投。他在2022年另有一次一安打完封，以及2024年7月25日对阵国民的无安打比赛。
自2010年8月16日 Shaun Marcum 以来，首次由蓝鸟投手投出的一安打完封。在此之前的八天，Brandon Morrow 也曾做到过，同时投出17次三振。
队史上只有10名投手曾投出过一安打或无安打的完封胜（合计15次）。
他的120球创下了生涯新高，是本赛季大联盟最高，也是自2025年8月31日 Justin Verlander 投出121球以来投手投出的最多球数。
Cease 是继队友 Shane Bieber（2021年在守护者队）之后，首位在同一赛季中两次出赛至少投出118球的投手。
再补充一个有趣的事实：Schneider 在球员时期曾与 Shaun Marcum 在高级1A达尼丁和3A雪城是室友。这已经是挺久以前的事了。
无论一支球队输球是一周、一个赛季还是十年，都需要有观看的理由。上世纪90年代末和21世纪初对蓝鸟来说是黯淡的时期，但 Carlos Delgado 每晚都在阵容中，每五天 Roy Halladay 就会登上投手丘。2026年的蓝鸟不太可能跌入另一个冰河期，但尽管如此，这感觉像是一个需要一些难忘时刻的失落赛季。
即使整个赛季的结果并不理想，球迷们只想看到自己的热情得到回应。这就是为什么看到 Cease 以他这种方式做到这一切如此重要——他主动要求更多，并证明自己能够做到。这也是他赢得 Schneider 和投手教练 Pete Walker 无比信任的另一个迹象，他们只是让这头猛兽继续发挥。
“这对我意义重大，”Cease 说。“第七局之后我进去说，‘我今天能投110球吗？’只是想看看我能不能完成完投。他们让我多投了10球。最后一局有很多界外球，但太棒了。我非常高兴他们让我去争取。”
比赛刚开始的几球，你绝对想不到会这样。坦率地说，看起来 Cease 更可能只投几局。第一局他的球速大约在93英里，对于一个通常能飙到100英里的投手来说，这是一个令人担忧的数字。但奇怪的是，这迫使 Cease 进行“投球”（如 Schneider 所说），并找到一些软弱的接触来让他保持在水面之上。
“我的身体一开始很僵硬，所以我只是利用现有的条件，确保投出好球，”Cease 说。“当我们打到第五局，我还在投无安打比赛时，我的身体稍微放松了一些。到最后，我看到了胜利的曙光。我只是全力以赴。”
竞争也正式开始了，Cease 和 Cam Schlittler 之间的美联赛扬奖争夺，这样的比赛只是不断提醒人们为什么 Cease 有机会。

items.titleEn: Cease (12 K's) shuts out Red Sox as Springer, Vladdy provide the offense
bodyEn: BOSTON -- The Blue Jays still have some flashes in them, especially when Dylan Cease pitches like that.
Saturday’s 6-0 win over the Red Sox was clean and simple, which we haven’t seen enough of from this 2026 team. The win moves the Blue Jays to 48-57.
This is what mattered most:
1. Dylan Cease one-hits the Red Sox

For a moment, it felt like Cease was going to take another run at Dave Stieb, like he did just before the All-Star break in San Francisco. Stieb still lives on as the only no-hitter in franchise history, but Cease was spectacular in Saturday’s win. This was the Blue Jays’ first complete game of the season as Cease allowed just one hit, a double to Andruw Monasterio in the sixth.
It’s the Blue Jays’ first complete game one-hitter since Shaun Marcum on August 16, 2010. Just eight days prior to that, Brandon Morrow did the same in his incredible 17-strikeout game.

Early on, his velocity was downright worrying. His fastball sat below 94 mph in the first inning, alarming from a pitcher who sits 97-98 mph and can touch 100 mph. It slowly crept up as the game went on, though, similar to what we’ve seen over the years from Kevin Gausman. To Cease’s credit, he also controlled this game extremely well, getting the Red Sox hitters to swing through some of his softer stuff while he settled in.
This still looks like Cease versus Cam Schlittler of the Yankees for the AL Cy Young Award. Cease now owns a 2.46 ERA with 167 strikeouts over 113 1/3 innings.
2) Stock up: George Springer

Springer’s three-run home run in the third inning snuck over the Green Monster in left and continued a stretch where he’s looked more like his 2025 self recently. Sure, the Blue Jays wish it had been this way all along, but better now than never.

Springer is one of the most interesting trade options on this roster, and will appeal to different clubs in very different ways. While some contenders simply would not have a spot for Springer, who is limited to the DH spot with the odd day in the corner outfield, other contenders in need of a veteran DH or bench bat could easily see the upside here. Springer is a former World Series MVP with the Astros, and last October, delivered one of the biggest moments in Blue Jays history with his Game 7 ALCS home run against the Mariners.

There’s a certain level of “feel” to Springer’s value, beyond the 2026 numbers. Consider the Red Sox to be one of the contenders who could make sense for Springer, but if he looks good in the coming days, that list may grow.

Money will be a factor, too. Springer is earning just over $24 million this year, the final year of his six-year, $150 million deal. This could be a scenario where the Blue Jays can eat some of that salary in return for a greater prospect return.
3) The right direction for Vladdy
Vladimir Guerrero Jr. reached base four times, including a line-drive single to left field to bring home the Blue Jays’ first run of the game.
Before the game, Guerrero met with the media to address the Blue Jays’ disappointing season, asking the fans for patience and preaching that anything can happen over their final 57 games.

“Before even thinking about [media] or the Trade Deadline, myself and the entire team have to play better,” Guerrero said through interpreter Hector Lebron. “Every time I leave the field, going back to the hotel, that’s all I’m thinking of, seeing how we can get better.”

Guerrero’s season won’t truly turn around until some of these start going over the wall, as he’s stuck at just six home runs this season. There’s no arguing with a day like this, though, and as manager John Schneider said before the game, it’s important for Guerrero to “show the way” to his teammates as they go through a down year.
items.titleZh: Cease（12K）完封红袜，Springer和Vladdy贡献火力
items.summaryZh: Dylan Cease仅被敲1安，蓝鸟6-0完封红袜，Springer轰出三分炮。
bodyZh: 波士顿——蓝鸟队仍有一些闪光点，尤其是当Dylan Cease投出这样的表现时。
周六以6-0战胜红袜的比赛干净利落，这支2026年的球队之前这样的表现并不多见。这场胜利让蓝鸟战绩来到48胜57负。
以下是比赛要点：
1. Dylan Cease只让红袜敲出一支安打。
一度看起来Cease要再次挑战Dave Stieb的纪录，就像全明星周末前在旧金山那样。Stieb仍然是队史唯一无安打比赛的保持者，但Cease在周六的胜利中表现出色。这是蓝鸟本赛季第一场完投，Cease只被击出1支安打——第六局Andruw Monasterio的二垒打。
这是自2010年8月16日Shaun Marcum之后，蓝鸟首次完成完投一安打比赛。在那之前8天，Brandon Morrow在惊人的17次三振比赛中也做到过。
比赛初期，他的球速令人担忧。第一局他的速球低于94英里/小时，对于一个通常投97-98英里/小时、可触及100英里/小时的投手来说，这令人警惕。但随着比赛进行，球速慢慢回升，类似于我们这些年看到的Kevin Gausman。值得称赞的是，Cease很好地控制了比赛，让红袜打者在他调整期间挥空了他的一些偏软球路。
Cease和洋基的Cam Schlittler仍然是美国联盟赛扬奖的竞争者。Cease现在自责分率2.46，在113.1局中投出167次三振。
2) 增值：George Springer
Springer在第三局的三分本垒打刚好越过左外野的绿色怪物，延续了他近期看起来更像2025年状态的表现。当然，蓝鸟希望他一直如此，但迟到总比没有好。
Springer是这支球队中最有趣的交易选项之一，会以不同方式吸引不同球队。虽然一些竞争者可能没有Springer的位置——他只能打指定打击，偶尔守角位外野——但其他需要资深指定打击或替补打者的竞争者很容易看到他的价值。Springer是前世界大赛MVP（随太空人获得），去年十月，他在美联冠军赛第七场对阵水手时轰出蓝鸟队史最重要的一支本垒打。
Springer的价值除了2026年的数据外，还有一定的“感觉”。考虑红袜作为可能适合Springer的竞争者之一，但如果他在接下来几天表现不错，这个名单可能会扩大。
金钱也是一个因素。Springer今年年薪超过2400万美元，这是他6年1.5亿美元合同的最后一年。可能会出现蓝鸟承担部分薪资以换取更高回报的潜力新秀的情况。
3) Vladdy走在正确方向
Vladimir Guerrero Jr.四次上垒，包括一支左外场平飞一垒安打，为蓝鸟送回比赛第一分。
赛前，Guerrero与媒体会面，谈到蓝鸟令人失望的赛季，请求球迷耐心，并强调在剩余57场比赛中任何事情都可能发生。
“在考虑（媒体）或交易截止日之前，我和整支球队必须打得更好，”Guerrero通过翻译Hector Lebron说道，“每次离开球场回酒店，我都在想我们如何才能变得更好。”
Guerrero的赛季不会真正好转，除非这些安打开始飞过墙外——他本赛季只有6支本垒打。但这样的一天无可争议，正如总教练John Schneider赛前所说，Guerrero在球队经历低迷年份时向队友“展示方向”很重要。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: In a much different spot than last season, Vlad Jr. talks about his struggles in '26
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Just over a year ago, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. stood in this same rugged hallway at Fenway Park. It was the beginning of the greatest year of his baseball life.

He’d just signed a $500 million contract that morning. He didn’t know it yet, but a World Series run was laid out in front of him, and in six months, he’d be the most popular man in the country. Saturday afternoon, he walked down that same hallway, between all of the brick and concrete, and last year suddenly felt so long ago.

We’re talking about endings now, not beginnings. The 47-57 Blue Jays are careening towards the Trade Deadline as sellers. Just as Guerrero’s brilliance defined the 2025 Blue Jays, his struggles define this year’s team.

Entering Saturday, Guerrero has just six home runs this season, tied for 223rd in baseball. Of the 147 qualified hitters, his .354 slugging percentage ranks Guerrero 132nd. Rays speedster Chandler Simpson, who’s never homered in the big leagues, sits one spot above him. Everywhere you look, this gets more stunning.

“There’s still 58 games left. I know I’m better than that and I know I can get better,” Guerrero said through interpreter Hector Lebron. “It’s frustrating. There’s 58 games left and you know how baseball is. Anything can happen. Myself and the rest of the guys, we’ve just got to continue to play hard.”

Guerrero asked fans to be patient, which is a tricky proposal. Blue Jays fans came into this season with World Series expectations, because of course they did. This season hasn’t just been a disappointment in the standings, it’s seen the Blue Jays lose the identity that made them a countrywide sensation in 2025. They’re dead last in MLB in runs scored. Unless you’re playing airtight defense with a few Cy Young candidates in the rotation, that’s never going to work.

The face of the franchise isn’t oblivious to this, of course. That $500 million contract signs you up for expectations and criticisms that others simply don’t face. We can debate where the line is on what’s “fair," but part of Guerrero’s job description is now to take on more media responsibilities, more pressure and more responsibility than everyone else in that clubhouse.

“He’s dealt with it forever, good or bad,” manager John Schneider said. “When he’s good, that’s what he’s supposed to do. When he’s not, it’s, ‘What the hell are you doing?’ He’s handling it well. It’s important for him to really show the way here when times are tough. He’s somebody who the guys look up to and follow. It’s a little extra for him. Him talking to you guys and saying he’s not playing as good as he can be and we’re not playing as good as we can be is accountability.”

There’s also a difference between public messaging and what happens when the clubhouse doors close. All of those times Schneider sits at the podium, holding steady for his team and preaching his belief in the next day? That’s just the version we see. Minutes later, he could be lighting up the clubhouse or sitting a player down in his office.

Schneider knows Guerrero as well as anyone, at least anyone without the last name “Guerrero." Beyond the 2025 World Series, he was right there for Guerrero’s best days as the No. 1 prospect in the game, standing on the top step of the dugout and watching on in awe. Schneider knows the incredible things Guerrero is capable of, but we haven’t seen them in too long.

“He’s trying to capture the same thing. When it’s right, he’s one of the best,” Schneider said. “He’s trying to get there and not reinvent himself at this point. It’s just being on time, hitting the ball hard and whatever happens is going to happen. It always comes down to what you’re swinging at. If he’s swinging in the zone, he’s pretty good.”

Guerrero isn’t the only reason the Blue Jays are in this spot, only one of dozens. If you look at that long list, though, Guerrero’s name stands out. It’s the most surprising story of the season, a season which is just over a week away from what could be a dark day at the Trade Deadline.
“I let the front office do their job,” Guerrero said. “I’m going to focus and concentrate on doing my job.”
That’s how he’s always wanted it. Guerrero’s job description changed in these Fenway hallways a year ago, though, and now, he’s seen both sides of what that brings.
items.titleZh: 与上赛季截然不同，小弗拉迪谈2026赛季挣扎
items.summaryZh: 小弗拉基米尔·格雷罗谈本赛季挣扎，蓝鸟队陷入困境。
bodyZh: 波士顿——就在一年多前，小弗拉基米尔·格雷罗站在芬威球场这条崎岖的走廊上。那是他棒球生涯最伟大一年的开始。
那天早上他刚签下一份5亿美元的合同。他还不知道，但一次世界大赛征程已摆在他面前，六个月后，他将成为这个国家最受欢迎的人。周六下午，他再次走过那条走廊，穿梭在砖石之间，去年突然感觉如此遥远。
现在我们谈论的是结局，而非开始。47胜57负的蓝鸟正作为卖家冲向交易截止日。正如格雷罗的辉煌定义了2025年的蓝鸟，他的挣扎定义了今年的球队。
截至周六，格雷罗本赛季仅打出6支本垒打，并列大联盟第223位。在147名符合资格的打者中，他的长打率.354排名第132位。光芒队快腿钱德勒·辛普森，这位从未在大联盟击出本垒打的球员，排名比他高一位。无论从哪个角度看，这都令人震惊。
“还有58场比赛。我知道我比这更好，我也知道我可以变得更好，”格雷罗通过翻译Hector Lebron表示，“这很令人沮丧。还有58场比赛，你知道棒球是什么样的。任何事情都可能发生。我和其他队友，我们只需要继续努力打球。”
格雷罗请求球迷保持耐心，这是一个棘手的提议。蓝鸟球迷带着世界大赛的期望进入本赛季，他们当然会这样。本赛季不仅在战绩上令人失望，蓝鸟还失去了让他们在2025年成为全国热点的身份。他们的得分在大联盟垫底。除非你拥有滴水不漏的防守和轮值中几位赛扬奖候选人，否则这永远行不通。
当然，球队的门面并非对此视而不见。那份5亿美元的合同带来了他人无需面对的期望和批评。我们可以争论“公平”的界限在哪里，但格雷罗的工作描述的一部分就是现在要承担比更衣室里其他人更多的媒体责任、更多的压力和更多的责任。
“他一直在处理这件事，无论好坏，”主教练John Schneider说，“当他表现好时，那是他该做的。当他表现不好时，就是‘你到底在搞什么？’他处理得很好。在困难时期，他真正起到带头作用很重要。他是队友们仰望和追随的人。这对他来说是额外的。他对你们媒体说他自己打得不够好，我们全队打得不够好，这是一种担当。”
公开信息与更衣室门关闭后发生的事情之间也存在差异。所有那些Schneider坐在讲台上，为球队保持镇定并宣扬他对明天的信念的时刻？那只是我们看到的版本。几分钟后，他可能会在更衣室里发火，或者叫球员到办公室谈话。
Schneider比任何人都了解格雷罗，至少比任何不姓“格雷罗”的人都了解。除了2025年世界大赛，他还见证了格雷罗作为头号新秀的最佳时光，站在休息区最高台阶上敬畏地观看。Schneider知道格雷罗能够做到多么不可思议的事情，但我们太久没有看到了。
“他在努力重现同样的东西。当一切都对了，他是最好的之一，”Schneider说，“他正在努力达到那个状态，而不是现在重新改造自己。只是要准时到位，用力击球，然后顺其自然。一切都归结于你在挥击什么球。如果他在好球带内挥棒，他就很出色。”
蓝鸟陷入这种境地，格雷罗不是唯一原因，只是众多原因之一。然而，如果你看看那长长的名单，格雷罗的名字格外突出。这是本赛季最令人惊讶的故事，而距离可能成为交易截止日黑暗日的时间只剩一周多。
“我让管理层做他们的工作，”格雷罗说，“我会专注并集中精力做好我的工作。”
他一直希望如此。然而，一年前在芬威的走廊里，格雷罗的工作描述发生了变化，而现在，他看到了这带来的两面。
